description: Search the Vedha360 library of Hindu scripture (Bhagavad Gītā, Upaniṣads, Purāṇas, Itihāsas and more). A verse reference such as 'BG 2.47' or 'Bhagavad Gita 2.47' is looked up exactly; any other text (a question or theme, e.g. 'duty without attachment to results') is semantic search. Results outside a work's free preview keep their reference but have no text (locked: true).

collection.description: Limit to one collection: bhagavad-gita, upanishads, vedas, puranas, itihasas, smritis, yoga, stotras
collection.title: Collection

lang.description: Language of the translation: en, hi, bn, mr, te, ta, gu, kn, ml, or, pa; 'sa' = Sanskrit (Devanāgarī), 'iast' = transliteration.
lang.title: Lang
